inverse_script.embedded_utf8_lf:
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, subprocess, sys
root = Path(sys.argv[1])
r = json.loads(Path(sys.argv[2]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
p = r["source_transformation"]
h = lambda b: hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
files = {}
for pin in p["after"]:
    b = (root / pin["path"]).read_bytes().replace(b"\r\n", b"\n")
    assert h(b) == pin["sha256"]
    files[pin["path"]] = b
for seam in reversed(p["seams"]):
    path = seam["path"]
    b = files[path]
    assert h(b) == seam["after_step_sha256"]
    added = seam["insert_utf8_lf"].encode("utf-8")
    assert h(added) == seam["insert_sha256"]
    at = seam["offset"]
    assert b[at:at + len(added)] == added
    b = b[:at] + b[at + len(added):]
    assert h(b) == seam["before_step_sha256"]
    files[path] = b
for pin in p["before"]:
    b = files[pin["path"]]
    assert h(b) == pin["sha256"]
    assert b == Path(pin["frozen_path"]).read_bytes()
    original = subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", r["baseline_commit"] + ":" + pin["path"]], cwd=root)
    assert b == original
for seam in p["seams"]:
    path = seam["path"]
    b = files[path]
    assert h(b) == seam["before_step_sha256"]
    at = seam["offset"]
    b = b[:at] + seam["insert_utf8_lf"].encode("utf-8") + b[at:]
    assert h(b) == seam["after_step_sha256"]
    files[path] = b
for pin in p["after"]:
    assert h(files[pin["path"]]) == pin["sha256"]
print("4 positional seams and both whole-file forward/inverses equal exact pinned Source")
